overview:
**Fire danger is High today, driven by persistently elevated fuel dryness (ERC 74%, BI 64%) despite calm winds.**
- The 7-day outlook keeps danger at High through September 10, with ERC holding in the 72–76% range and only light, scattered rain expected.
- Winds stay light (5–9 mph, NE/ENE) with warm days near 66–71°F and afternoon humidity recovery into the 30s–40s.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted, and 0 of 7 local watchout indicators are currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM Gunnison and Uncompahgre Field Office lands across Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, San Juan, San Miguel, and Delta counties; Gunnison County and unincorporated Montrose County are under Stage 2.
- The Elk Fire, 7 miles northwest of Lake City in Hinsdale County, is holding at 7,257 acres and is 73% contained, with minimal fire behavior and area/road closures still in place.
